question: Should this narrow Crestodian providerless-model setup handoff land independently of the broader guided CLI onboarding work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101880?
rationale: Automation can repair the lint blocker, but it cannot choose the permanent product boundary for two open setup/onboarding PRs that both address providerless first-run model access.

options.title: Fix and review as narrow handoff
options.body: Repair the lint blocker, keep this PR scoped to Crestodian's post-bootstrap provider prompt, and let the broader onboarding PR proceed separately.

options.title: Pause behind guided onboarding
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader guided onboarding direction lands or is closed so there is only one providerless setup path to review.

recommendation.title: Fix and review as narrow handoff
recommendation.body: Repair the lint blocker, keep this PR scoped to Crestodian's post-bootstrap provider prompt, and let the broader onboarding PR proceed separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the overlapping guided onboarding PR and are the best routing candidate for the product-boundary decision.
